TP-Link WR840N 300Mbps Wi-Fi Router TL-WR840N delivers wireless speeds of up to 300Mbps on the 2.4GHz band using IEEE 802.11b/g/n standards. It features four 10/100Mbps Ethernet ports, including one WAN port and three LAN ports, two fixed antennas, WEP, WPA/WPA2 wireless security, WDS bridging, and IP-based bandwidth control.
